annotations.title: Prepare a purchase for the person to confirm

description: Never buys anything and never spends money. Checks prices for releases or tracks and returns links where the person confirms the purchase in the browser. With addToCart the items are put into the person's Bitsound cart, which the person checks out on the website.

addToCart.description: true also puts the items into the person's cart (default false)

items.description: 1-20 items, each with either release or track

name: purchase_prepare
